raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

For non-separator rerankers, a positive `max_tokens_per_doc` could change the prompt and score even when it didn't truncate the document. This limits the document first, then tokenizes the combined prompt once. Separator-based rerankers are unchanged.

## Reproducer

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from vllm import LLM, PoolingParams

llm = LLM(
    model="tomaarsen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B-seq-cls",
    runner="pooling",
    dtype="half",
    seed=17,
    trust_remote_code=True,
    hf_overrides={"use_sep_token": False},
    enforce_eager=True,
    max_model_len=128,
    max_num_batched_tokens=128,
    gpu_memory_utilization=0.25,
)
try:
    for name, limit in (("uncapped", None), ("nonbinding_100", 100)):
        extra = None if limit is None else {"max_tokens_per_doc": limit}
        out = llm.score(
            "alpha ",
            "beta gamma delta epsilon",
            pooling_params=PoolingParams(use_activation=False, extra_kwargs=extra),
            tokenization_kwargs={"add_special_tokens": False},
            use_tqdm=False,
        )[0]
        print(f"{name}: ids={list(out.prompt_token_ids)} raw={out.outputs.score:.12f}")
finally:
    llm.llm_engine.engine_core.shutdown()
PY
```

## Output on main / on branch

Main: `uncapped: ids=[7141, 13440, 21619, 9477, 31204] tokens=5 raw=-2.060278892517 final=0.113017871976 finite=True`

Main: `nonbinding_100: ids=[7141, 220, 19127, 21619, 9477, 31204] tokens=6 raw=-2.034487962723 final=0.115629188716 finite=True`

Branch: `uncapped: ids=[7141, 13440, 21619, 9477, 31204] tokens=5 raw=-2.060278892517 final=0.113017871976 finite=True`

Branch: `nonbinding_100: ids=[7141, 13440, 21619, 9477, 31204] tokens=5 raw=-2.060278892517 final=0.113017871976 finite=True`

On the branch, the non-binding limit matches the uncapped prompt and score.

## Test Plan

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 HF_HUB_CACHE=/tmp/codex-pr57666-hf-cache \
  HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=ERROR \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/pooling/scoring/test_cross_encoder_offline.py -q
```

`6 passed, 15 warnings in 14.49s`, including all three SentenceTransformers reference tests. 

## AI assistance disclosure

OpenAI Codex (GPT-6) helped draft the implementation.
